user_input: Execute the end-to-end single task: migrate the Cantilounge application database/auth backend from Supabase/PostgreSQL to local XAMPP MySQL/MariaDB using C:\stuff\cantilounge-hub_v2\cantilounge-hub\cantilounge_xampp.sql as the target schema. Preserve POS, authentication, and other features where feasible. Implement a compatible MySQL server API/backend and migrate the client usage. Inspect all relevant source/config files and schema; do not expose or delete secrets. Validate TypeScript/build/tests, report changed files, architecture, limitations, schema redesign needs, concrete blockers, and user actions. Workspace: C:\stuff\cantilounge-hub_v2\cantilounge-hub. This is not Azure migration.
title: Supabase/PostgreSQL to Local MySQL/MariaDB Rewrite

assessment_snapshot.intro: The supplied scenario describes a brownfield full-stack rewrite of the Cantilounge application:
bullets: Existing src, supabase, public, and scripts areas
Supabase/PostgreSQL is the detected existing backend platform
The target is a local XAMPP MySQL/MariaDB server API with a supplied SQL schema
Source, configuration, and schema inspection is deferred until clarification completes

proposed_outcome: Rewrite the application in place or at an accepted output location, replace Supabase/PostgreSQL data and auth usage with a compatible local Node.js/MySQL API where feasible, preserve POS and authentication behavior, and migrate the client through validated build and test gates.
